review_candidates.title: Senior Product Engineer / Full-Stack Developer (Internal Systems)
review_candidates.description: Job Title: Senior Product Engineer / Full-Stack Developer (Internal Systems) Location: Cairo, Egypt (Nasr City) Position Type: Full-Time (UK Hours Monday to Friday) About the Role: We are seeking an entrepreneurial, highly capable Senior Full-Stack Product Engineer to spearhead the development of our company’s internal digital ecosystem. Our operations currently run on various third-party software providers. Your mandate will be to transition these operations in-house by designing and building a unified, custom platform tailored uniquely to our proprietary business processes. This is a solo-builder role designed for a developer who leverages cutting-edge AI development workflows (e.g., Cursor, Claude, LLM-assisted generation) to compress development cycles and act as a highly efficient engineering unit. Core Projects & Responsibilities: Enterprise Platform Architecture: Design and build integrated, web-based modules for our internal business operations: CAFM (Computer-Aided Facility Management): Job scheduling desks, reactive maintenance tickets, asset logs, and job sheets. CRM (Customer Relationship Management): Client data pipelines and interaction tracking. HR & ATS (Applicant Tracking System): Employee profiles, onboarding documentation, and recruitment pipeline tracking. Workflow Mapping: Take our existing operational workflows (currently managed via third-party systems) and translate them into a singular, cohesive database schema. Mobile App Development: Architect and deploy a future cross-platform mobile application (iOS/Android) for our field technicians, with a heavy emphasis on offline-first data caching for environments with poor cellular service. Web Management: Maintain, optimize, and implement ongoing updates to our corporate marketing website. Backend & Security: Set up robust data security, user permission tiers, and automated database backups using modern Backend-as-a-Service platforms or custom cloud infrastructure. Required Qualifications: 5+ Years of Experience in full-stack development, with a documented track record of shipping production-ready web platforms and mobile apps independently. Mobile Framework Mastery: Deep experience with Flutter or React Native (essential for our future mobile rollout). Database & Infrastructure: Strong experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL/MySQL) and cloud infrastructure/BaaS platforms (e.g., Supabase, Firebase, AWS). Mandatory Technical Hurdle: Proven experience designing offline-first mobile applications featuring local storage synchronization. AI-Native Workflow: Daily proficiency using advanced AI code assistants to streamline boilerplate coding, UI layouts, and API integrations. Product Ownership: Ability to take direct operational feedback, screenshots, or workflow descriptions and turn them into functional layouts without requiring a dedicated UI/UX design team. Fluent in written and spoken English.

review_candidates.title: Trade Contracts Specialist
review_candidates.description: City : Cairo State : Al Qāhirah (EG-C) Country : Egypt (EG) Requisition Number : 45865 Trade Contracts Specialist – Cairo, Egypt Are you a detail-oriented contract professional who thrives on accuracy, structure, and collaboration? Do you enjoy working at the heart of commercial operations, ensuring that contract terms are correctly translated into practice? At Bunge, we are looking for a Trade Contracts Specialist to join our team in Egypt. In this role, you will own and safeguard the accuracy and integrity of contracts across their lifecycle. You will act as a key control point, ensuring that contractual agreements are correctly reflected and aligned with pricing, invoicing, and related activities, in close collaboration with both internal and external stakeholders. This role is focused on contract accuracy , compliance , and validation , while working in close coordination and alignment with commodity trade execution. What You Will Do Review and validate commodity purchase and sales confirmations entered by traders into SAP. Ensure all contracts accurately reflect agreed commercial terms and contain complete and correct clauses. Validate contract pricing against agreed terms in close collaboration with trading and finance teams. Work closely with finance to verify invoicing accuracy and ensure alignment with contract conditions. Ensure consistency between contracts, pricing data, and supporting financial and operational documentation. Review contracts with field offices, brokers, and third-party counterparties. Generate and validate third-party sales contracts in internal systems. Confirm contracts with external counterparties in a timely and professional manner. Monitor contract status in SAP and proactively follow up with relevant stakeholders. Maintain and apply business rules governing contract structures and clauses. Act as a key control point, ensuring downstream activities remain aligned with contractual agreements. Identify opportunities for process improvements and contribute to operational excellence initiatives. Support knowledge sharing and onboarding within the team. Required What you bring Minimum 3–4 years of experience in contract administration or a similar role within a commercial, finance, or supply chain environment. Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong understanding of contract lifecycle management, with exposure to pricing and invoicing processes. Experience working with SAP (or similar ERP systems) — strongly preferred and highly beneficial given system complexity. High level of accuracy and attention to detail, with a structured way of working. Strong analytical skills, with the ability to reconcile and validate complex data. Proficiency in Microsoft Office, especially Excel. Fluency in English (written and spoken) is required. Preferred Knowledge of FOSFA and/or GAFTA contracts. General knowledge of Incoterms is considered a plus. Experience in agricultural commodities, trading, or supply chain environments. Experience working in an international or multicultural organization. How You’ll Collaborate Act as a proactive intermediary between trading, finance, operations, and legal teams. Communicate clearly and professionally with both internal and external stakeholders. Support the resolution of contract-related, pricing, and invoicing queries. Ensure contracts are accurate, complete, and aligned across all involved functions. Why join Bunge in Egypt Join a global leader in agribusiness and commodity trading. Be part of a dynamic and growing market within the Middle East & North Africa region. Work in an international environment with exposure to global trade flows. Competitive compensation and benefits aligned with your experience and impact. Opportunities for career growth and internal mobility across Bunge’s global network. A culture that values ownership, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Interested? Click the Apply button and let’s connect. We look forward to hearing from you. At Bunge (NYSE: BG), our purpose is to connect farmers to consumers to deliver essential food, feed and fuel to the world. As a premier agribusiness solutions provider, our team of :34,000 dedicated employees partner with farmers across the globe to move agricultural commodities from where they’re grown to where they’re needed—in faster, smarter, and more efficient ways. We are a world leader in grain origination, storage, distribution, oilseed processing and refining, offering a broad portfolio of plant-based oils, fats, and proteins. We work alongside our customers at both ends of the value chain to deliver quality products and develop tailored, innovative solutions that address evolving consumer needs. With 200+ years of experience and presence in over 50 countries, we are committed to strengthening global food security, advancing sustainability, and helping communities prosper where we operate. Bunge has its registered office in Geneva, Switzerland and its corporate headquarters in St. Louis, Missouri. Learn more at Bunge.com. Every day our people exemplify these values, which represent Bunge at its core: We Are One Team – Collaborative, Respectful, Inclusive We Lead The Way – Agile, Empowered, Innovative We Do What’s Right – Safety, Sustainability, With Integrity If this sounds like you, join us! We value and invest in people who believe in our purpose and are excited to live it every day – people who are #ProudtoBeBunge

review_candidates.title: Sr. Client Delivery Analyst
review_candidates.description: We’re reinventing the market research industry. Let’s reinvent it together. At Numerator, we believe tomorrow’s success starts with today’s market intelligence. We empower the world’s leading brands and retailers with unmatched insights into consumer behavior and the influencers that drive it. Job Title & Location Data Quality Manager - Africa & Middle East Cairo, Egypt Role Purpose The Manager of Panel Data Quality is the critical link between Client Service and Operations, keeping Worldpanel International's household consumer panel data across Africa and the Middle East both technically sound and client ready. You will translate complex data issues into clear, actionable insight for client-facing teams, while owning the integrity of the panel data behind every insight we deliver. Key Responsibilities Client Service & Stakeholder Partnership Expert Advisory: Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) for Client Service teams, providing guidance on complex data quality matters and methodology in terms they can act on. Stakeholder Management: Balance the high-pressure needs of Client Service with the practical constraints of Operations, negotiating solutions that satisfy both quality and delivery timelines. Data Production & Monthly Sign-off Release Validation: Review and sign off on monthly data production for the MENA region, ensuring all trends are logical and data is market ready. Outlier Management: Identify and investigate statistical outliers, recommending and implementing data adjustments where necessary. Investigations & Troubleshooting Root Cause Analysis: Lead deep-dive investigations into data discrepancies or client-reported issues. Collaborative Resolution: Work closely with the Operations team to implement fixes for identified data quality gaps. Innovation & Process Enhancement Technical Evolution: Identify and track new technical solutions to automate or improve current manual processes. Panel Modernization: Support new panel launches and enhancements with expertise in Field Management and Product Dictionaries. Core Competencies & Capabilities We are looking for a proactive leader who balances analytical skepticism with commercial diplomacy. The ideal candidate will demonstrate the following: Analytical Rigor & Quality Ownership Investigates the "why" behind trends to distinguish genuine market shifts from collection errors. Acts as the last line of defense for data accuracy, focusing on root-cause fixes rather than symptom management. Strategic Influence & Change Leadership A self-starter who proactively sets the agenda, anticipates issues before they arise, and troubleshoots root causes to suggest process enhancements. Understands how operational changes ripple across the wider business and can lead teams through transitions independently. Stakeholder Diplomacy & Communication Balances commercial urgency with operational constraints, giving Client Service the clear answers they need for client discussions. A versatile communication style - equally able to explain complex data issues to non-technical stakeholders and to build strong internal networks. What You'll Bring to Numerator Prerequisites To be considered for this role, candidates must possess the following foundational technical and industry competencies: Core: Fundamental Understanding of Market Research: A strong grasp of panel methodologies, sampling techniques, and the nuances of consumer behavior data. Background with market research particularly in analyzing data and managing client requests. Ability to extract and wrangle data from multiple sources into clean, usable formats. Strong Excel and PowerPoint skills for stakeholder reporting. Ability to manage multiple projects at a time. Strong communication skills Nice to have: Familiarity with data cleaning pipelines and anomaly detection. Basic statistics (distributions, significance testing). Python for data wrangling or analysis.

review_candidates.title: Legal Project/Program Manager ⚖️⚙️📊 (American Injury Law | Legal Program Manager, Workflow Optimization, Capacity Planning, Change Management, Forecasting | Remote)
review_candidates.description: About the Company We're a plaintiff's catastrophic contingency fee law firm with specialized units in mass tort and medical malpractice. Our mission, echoing our founder's guiding principle: " to win the case that can't be won, for the family who can't afford to lose. " Unlike traditional personal injury firms, we exclusively handle catastrophic injury and wrongful death cases. We prepare every case for trial, recognizing that clients with devastating injuries have fundamentally different needs than those with moderate injuries. Our Trial Lawyers fully litigate each matter with unwavering dedication. Our clients are individuals across the United States fighting David vs. Goliath battles against powerful corporations. We level the playing field in these underdog contests, representing people, never companies. Rather than focusing on personal injury, we deliver personal victory: helping clients reclaim their lives when justice is finally served. Our landmark victories include $60 million against General Motors, $82 million against Celsius Holdings, and $27 million for a pressure cooker explosion. Named " Personal Injury Law Firm of the Year " three consecutive years, we're featured on CNN, CBS News, and recognized by Best Lawyers, Super Lawyers, and U.S. News & World Report. OUR COMPANY VALUES guide our team and shape our culture: 🤝All Hands on Deck: We win as a team, stepping up for colleagues regardless of formal role boundaries. ⚡Walk Fast: The work matters, so we stay organized and advance cases daily without delay. 🚘Drive All Night: We do whatever it takes — our commitment is our competitive edge. ✨Stand Out: We create exceptional client experiences through meticulous, memorable work. 🔍Don't Forget the Basics: We master the details, because a single oversight can change someone's life. We're a fully remote organization with 50-60 professionals working in nimble, high-performing teams of 3-8 people. Headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, Florida, our talent spans across the United States—with Attorneys in California and Chicago—plus international team members in the Philippines, Pakistan, Nigeria. Kenya, Mexico, Colombia and Brazil. Our environment isn't about making money; it's about saving lives. We handle catastrophic cases where the stakes couldn't be higher, creating an intensity and purpose we embrace. Every detail matters profoundly; even a single typo can affect a client's outcome. This creates a workplace where your contribution directly changes lives, offering a sense of purpose rarely found elsewhere. About the Role We're looking for a remote Legal Project/Program Manager to build and run the operational backbone of our litigation division, a team managing a few hundred active cases across five American cities. In this role, you'll audit our current systems, rebuild workflows, and manage the day-to-day production machine so our Lawyers can focus on winning cases. This isn't about tweaking a well-oiled system; you're building one from messy foundations, with the full support of firm leadership and Trial Lawyers . This role is internally facing; you won't be client-facing yourself, though the people you manage are. Right now, the firm's ability to take on more cases and reach more families is held back by operational capacity rather than by demand or will. This position exists to close that gap. Our IDEAL CANDIDATE brings 6+ years of relevant project or program management experience, whether that's a legal-specific background in plaintiff's contingency fee law or mass tort (with or without legal PM certifications), or project management experience built more broadly in professional services. Experience managing a group of Paralegals across that kind of caseload counts too, even without an exact title match, and you don't need to be a lawyer to succeed here, just a clear read on complexity and how to move work through people. You're the kind of presence that makes a team feel instantly more "pro": you walk into a meeting, quickly diagnose what's broken, and lay out a fix people trust. You lead like a head coach, not just executing the work yourself but running the team around you so everyone's playing their position well, and you understand the stakes go beyond this team: get this right, and it opens the door for the firm to expand into new cities and help more people. Performance Metrics: Your performance will be measured by how smoothly operations run, how quickly incidents get resolved with lasting fixes, how well the firm can scale capacity while maintaining quality, and the accuracy of your forecasting in preventing problems before they surface. Reporting Structure: You'll be in the Litigation division, working closely with Paralegals , Legal Assistants , Intake Specialists , Associate Attorneys , and other members of the firm leadership team. This position reports directly to the Attorney . You'll be doing things like: System Audit & Process Redesign: evaluating current workflows; identifying bottlenecks; restructuring roles and processes to support scalability; documenting new processes as standard operating procedures Tooling & Technology: upgrading the firm's project management stack, including new platforms; using the case management system to track case progress; leveraging AI tools for documentation and workflow efficiency Project-Level Coordination & Troubleshooting (per case) : coordinating the full team behind each case from intake through trial; keeping cases on schedule; troubleshooting delays; refining workflows to prevent recurring issues Program-Level Management (across the full caseload) : tracking case statuses across active programs; surfacing status data and dashboards for leadership; monitoring team capacity and staffing needs to keep pace with caseload; forecasting bottlenecks before they surface Team Communication & Cadence: running regular huddles and meeting cadences with project leads; keeping attorneys and leadership updated on progress Financial Tracking & Reporting: tracking and reporting cost per project Hiring & Resourcing Strategy: collaborating on expansion planning into new cities; defining new roles needed to support that growth; participating in vetting candidates to confirm fit Skills & Qualifications 6+ years of experience in a legal-specific project/program management role (e.g., Legal Project Manager , Mass Tort Manager ), or in a Program Manager , Project Manager , or Operations Manager role within high-volume professional services more broadly — legal or plaintiff's-side experience is a plus, not a requirement Project or program management experience with demonstrated success in building or overhauling systems Strong analytical skills: forecasting, capacity planning, resource optimization Experience managing high-volume, lifecycle-driven projects in deadline-driven, high-stakes environments Tech-savvy, comfortable learning and implementing new platforms quickly Extremely organized with sharp attention to process and detail Problem-solver who spots issues early and implements fixes Excellent written and verbal communication in English Diplomatic with strong EQ Skilled at driving process change while operations stay fully up and running Skilled at building buy-in across teams without formal authority over them Comfortable operating in ambiguous, still-forming environments without a playbook already in place Bonus if you also have: Legal project management certification (PMP, Legal Lean Sigma Green Belt or higher, IILPM LPP or higher, AIPM CPPM or higher, LPM Institute Advanced Certification) Experience in plaintiff's contingency fee law or mass tort settings Background managing paralegal or legal operations teams American-based law firm or legal organization experience Bilingual capabilities (English/Spanish or English/Creole) A law degree (even without practicing law) Experience with AI and automation tools for documentation and workflows Familiarity with our tools: LeadDocket, Zoom, MS Office suite, MS Outlook, OneDrive, Dropbox, ChatGPT Position Details Working Hours: 8:30 AM–5:00 PM ET (Eastern Time), with a 1-hour break. Adjusts with Daylight Saving Time . Some flexibility earned over time. Employment Type: Full-time (40 hours/week), Exclusivity Preferred Education: No formal degree required; relevant work experience and demonstrated project management capability are what matter here. Level: Senior (6+ years of relevant work experience) Compensation: Competitive, based on experience and region. Structured as a Consultant Agreement (independent contractor), meaning you'll be responsible for your own taxes, benefits, and insurance. Benefits of working with us: 🚀 Work directly with a forward-thinking international company 🏆 Join a team of incredibly talented colleagues 🎯 Own your work-life balance: 8 hours a day, 5 days a week 🏡 Thrive in a remote-friendly culture, working from the comfort of your home 💰 Earn above-market pay for your region 🧠 Access ongoing learning & growth opportunities ⚖️ Be part of landmark victories and high-profile cases that restore hope and dignity to families when it matters most
